The whole-box exchange of F2 would be wrong here.

F1y.fix: svpt := svpt + df for both players (raw w_svpt += w_df and l_svpt += l_df); every other count unchanged
F1y.reasons: Bad Gastein R16 Stosur d. Koukalova 6-1 6-0. As recorded Koukalova's 9 double faults exceed her 6 second-serve points (B6), impossible if serve points include double faults; with +df every check B0-B9 passes. The games identity holds exactly (12-1), which does not involve svpt; points per game 6.2 after the fix; the box appears in no other raw row. The extreme double-fault rate is what selects a row into B6: with the 2015 convention, rows with more double faults than second serves in play are 0.14% of the 30 events' raw rows against 0.11-0.17% in clean WTA data, so nothing beyond the known fault is indicated.
